copy.store_long:
Last Human Standing is a daily real-world elimination game built for verified humans. No bots, no random chance—just a brutal test of who shows up. The rules are simple:
1. The Theme: Each day, a new real-world theme drops (e.g., "AT A CAFÉ" or "A SUNRISE").
2. The Proof: Snap a photo matching the theme from anywhere on Earth.
3. The Audit: The community votes HUMAN or SUS on your proof.
4. The Elimination: The cap shrinks every day. Fail the audit or miss the window, and you're out.
5. The Prize: The last human standing takes the entire on-chain prize pool.

Built exclusively for World App, Last Human Standing uses World ID to ensure one human, one slot. Reserve your place in the next cohort, lock in your entry, and prove you're still here. One remains. Will it be you?

value.executive_summary: Delivered a complete, brand-forward launch creative package for Last Human Standing, including 9 final PNG assets (icon, content card, 4 showcase phone creatives, 3 social assets), a structured copy sheet with hooks and captions, long/short World Store descriptions, and a full verified asset inventory. A deterministic export script was used to ensure exact PNG dimensions and safe-area compliance. All assets were assembled, validated against the art direction (cold system / warm human), and packaged into Last_Human_Standing_Launch_Creatives.zip alongside supporting files (creative_system.md, copy_deliverables.md, reference_review_notes.md, structured_output.json). The final package is ready for upload to the World Developer Portal and posting across social channels.
value.world_store_notes: Reference review notes captured during development; assets honor the cold system / warm human contrast with tactile gouache motifs. The World Store content card adheres to the bottom safe area (no important detail within the lower 94px). The hero brand name Last Human Standing remains the focal point on key frames. All assets avoid purple AI-slop, generic glass dashboards, World App logos, and gambling/lottery language, aligning with the skill-based mechanic. The final asset set has been exported as exact PNGs at their target dimensions and packaged for deployment. For download access: ZIP bundle at file:///home/ubuntu/lhs_launch_assets/Last_Human_Standing_Launch_Creatives.zip; individual PNGs accessible under file:///home/ubuntu/lhs_launch_assets/final_png/; copy sheets and references are included in the archive.
